user.title: Set up Muslim Prayer Companion
user.description: Choose where your prayer times come from. You can add the integration more than once, for example one entry per mosque or location.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {location}
reconfigure.description: Change the source, mosque, location or calculation method. Your other settings are kept.

ireland.title: Select a mosque
ireland.description: Nearest to your Home Assistant location: {nearest}.

data_description.location_name: Shown in entity names. Leave empty to use the mosque's short name.

location.title: Location
location.description: Prayer times are calculated for this location.

data_description.location_name: Shown in entity names, for example Home or Office.

method.title: Calculation method
method.description: Select the convention used to calculate Fajr and Isha.

abort.already_configured: This mosque or location is already configured

init.title: {location}
init.description: Prayer times for {location} come from {source}. To change the mosque, location or source, use Reconfigure in the entry's menu.

iqamah.title: Iqamah times
iqamah.description: How the congregation (iqamah) times are obtained. Offsets are used as a fallback whenever a published time is missing.

data_description.iqamah_api_url: Only used with the custom API method. The URL must return JSON with the five prayers, for example {"Fajr": "06:30", "Dhuhr": "13:30", ...}.

offsets.name: Offsets after the start of each prayer
offsets.description: Minutes between the start of the prayer and the iqamah.

data_description.hijri_adjustment: Shift the Hijri date by up to two days to follow your local moon sighting announcements.
data_description.hijri_change_at_maghrib: When on, the Hijri date (and Ramadan, special nights) advances at Maghrib instead of at midnight.
data_description.imsak_minutes: Minutes before Fajr at which the Imsak sensor is set.

data_description.enabled_groups: Prayer-time sensors are always created. Disabled groups are removed on save.
data_description.prayer_window_minutes: For this many minutes after a prayer starts, the current prayer period shows the prayer itself instead of "Between ...".

friday.title: Friday prayers
friday.description: Track the Jumu'ah times of one or more mosques. Configured: {mosques}.

friday_add.title: Add a mosque
friday_add.description: Choose a mosque that publishes its Jumu'ah times, or enter the times yourself. Entered times are also used as a fallback when nothing is published.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the selected mosque's name.
data_description.label_1: Optional, for example "Men only" or "Arabic khutbah".

friday_remove.title: Remove mosques
friday_remove.description: The selected mosques and their sensors are removed.

error.name_exists: A mosque with this name is already in the list
error.invalid_time: Enter a time as HH:MM, for example 13:30
error.time_required: Enter at least the first Jumu'ah time
error.jumuah_order: The second Jumu'ah must be after the first
error.too_many_mosques: You can track at most 10 mosques
error.label_too_long: Labels can be at most 40 characters
error.url_required: The custom API method needs a URL

options.ie-icci: Islamic Cultural Centre of Ireland (ICCI), Clonskeagh
Islamic Cultural Centre of Ireland (ICCI) - manual times
options.ie-mai: Muslim Association of Ireland (MAI), Tallaght - manual times

options.tehran: Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran
options.france: Union des Organisations Islamiques de France
options.russia: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Russia

options.special_dates: Ramadan, Imsak, Iftar and special dates

provider_fallback.title: {location}: prayer times are calculated, not from {mosque}
provider_fallback.description:
The prayer times of {mosque} could not be read ({url}): {error}

Until the source works again, {location} shows times from the {fallback} for its coordinates. The `source` attribute of the prayer-time sensors shows which is in use. This issue closes itself when the source recovers.

date_not_available.message: {source} only publishes today's and tomorrow's prayer times; {date} is not available.

entry_not_found.message: No Muslim Prayer Companion entry with id {entry_id} is loaded.

no_entries.message: No Muslim Prayer Companion entry is set up.

get_prayer_times.name: Get prayer times
get_prayer_times.description: Returns the prayer times of one or more days for a configured location or mosque.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The location or mosque to use. Defaults to the first configured entry.

date.name: Start date
date.description: First day to return. Defaults to today.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of consecutive days to return (1 to 366). Mosque APIs can only return today and tomorrow.
